text:
Alex H: Quick check — vendor just messaged that UK-east has 12 A100 standby slots available for the next 7 days. Can we run a small canary with 4 nodes tomorrow morning? Need to confirm tenant quotas and firmware compatibility.
Maria G: Which tenants would we borrow from? demo or staging? Also curious about cost estimate.
Samir: I can pull tenant quotas now. Which workload is the canary targeting (latency smoke or throughput)? @Devon (oncall) FYI.
Devon (oncall): Oncall here — I can check capacity mapping and preemptible mix. Give me ~30m to confirm.
vendor-bot: Allocation hold placed (24h) — reference ABC123. Holds 4 A100 nodes pending confirmation.
Alex H: Thanks — last time we hit a firmware mismatch on uk-east racks, want to avoid that. Any serial/firmware ETA? :grimacing:
Maria G: For 4 nodes I recommend autoscale max=6 to give buffer, and set batch_size=8 for the throughput test. We should also ensure quantized model artifact is available on the pool.
Samir: Quotas checked: tenant-prod has 2 reserved A100s, demo has 8 free slots right now. We can request a temporary borrow from demo. Filing internal request now (will paste PR).
Alex H: If demo borrow works, I'll schedule the smoke at 09:30 UTC. Can someone approve borrow so vendor hold isn't released?
Devon (oncall): Approved borrow for 4 nodes from demo until 2024-06-15. :thumbsup: Please remember to release when done.
Maria G: Also add the monitoring hook: `/alerts add gpu-temp > 85 --scope canary` so we don't miss overheating during the run.
vendor-bot: Provisioning started — JobID JB-7890. Estimated provisioning time ~45m.
Alex H: Solid. If provisioning slips >1h ping me here. Otherwise I'll start canary when JB-7890 reports ready.
Samir: PR created: https://git.internal/infra/terraform/pulls/412 — terraform change adds temporary attachment to demo pool. cc: @Alex H
Alex H: Got the PR, will review quickly. I plan to run a 15-minute smoke set (latency p50/p95 + token throughput) and post numbers.
Devon (oncall): Quick reminder to run KV cache warmup before the smoke — avoids cold KV tail effects.
Devon (oncall): ```bash
# KV cache warmup
python tools/warmup.py --model redwood-7b --tokens 1024 --parallel 8
```
vendor-bot: JB-7890 status: NODES_ONLINE (4/4) — provisioning complete.
Alex H: Smoke done — 4-node canary: p50=120ms, p95=250ms, tokens/s stable. No firmware errors observed. Releasing demo borrow now.
Samir: Thanks — I've merged the terraform PR to detach automatically after 2 hours.
Devon (oncall): Closing the hold with vendor and noting in runbook. Good job everyone.
Alex H: Nice. I'll file a short postmortem notes entry with perf graphs later today. Thanks all. :rocket:
